terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These general terms are a temporary version for the current prototype and will be refined before launch.
items: Bewegesund provides educational movement, rehabilitation, and training content. It does not replace medical diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care.
You are responsible for entering accurate account and health-related information. Optional data helps personalize recommendations but can be added later.
If you experience acute pain, dizziness, chest pain, shortness of breath, neurological symptoms, or other warning signs, stop training and contact a medical professional.
Your account data is stored in Firebase and used inside the application for profile display, access control, training progress, and future recommendations.
Do not share your login credentials. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.
Programs, recommendations, and live sessions may change as the service develops.
